svg.title: Real people (Caltech CMDP): calibrated iris distance
svg.desc: Two-panel chart, measurement on a public dataset of 43 real people. Left: reading after calibrating at the 2 ft mark vs camera-to-eye distance, log scale, one dot per person and distance. Right: signed error by distance. 3 ft: reference-corrected median |error| 7.0% (90th percentile 17.8%), marks as given median +14.6%; 4 ft: reference-corrected median |error| 4.9% (90th percentile 14.0%), marks as given median +24.5%; 6 ft: reference-corrected median |error| 7.1% (90th percentile 13.6%), marks as given median +27.0%; 8 ft: reference-corrected median |error| 6.9% (90th percentile 17.8%), marks as given median +31.3%; 12 ft: reference-corrected median |error| 7.0% (90th percentile 13.3%), marks as given median +36.7%; 16 ft: reference-corrected median |error| 7.5% (90th percentile 15.6%), marks as given median +39.4%.
svg.text: Real people (Caltech CMDP): calibrated iris distance
43 people. Median |error| 6.6% once the dataset's distance reference is corrected; 28.8% with its floor marks as given.

svg.text: App code (Face Landmarker + irisWidthNorm); zoom divided out with EXIF focal length; reference offset -186 mm, refit without each person.
Tests 61–488 cm; the app works at 25–70 cm. Data: Burgos-Artizzu, Ronchi, Perona (ECCV 2014), CC-BY. /data/cmdp.json
